name: rolementions
description: Role mention analytics with timed, automatic mention protection for sensitive roles.

configFields.label: Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel where mention blocks and restorations are logged.

configFields.label: Protected Roles
configFields.description: Roles temporarily made non-mentionable when they are mentioned.

configFields.label: Auto Block Minutes
configFields.description: Minutes a protected role stays non-mentionable after a mention.

configFields.label: Analytics Enabled
configFields.description: Count role mentions per UTC day. Disable to skip analytics entirely.

endUserDataStatement: Stores aggregate per-role mention counts with a 48-hour TTL and temporary role block state. No message content, author IDs, or other user data is stored.
